Customer Reviews

Mike_T - 5 stars

Great screen protector! Crystal clear and easy to install. The 9H hardness really works - no scratches after months of use. Good fingerprint resistant coating too, my screen stays clean throughout the day.

Sarah_K - 4 stars

Easy bubble-free installation as advertised. The clarity is excellent. However, I wish it was a bit more fingerprint resistant. Still a solid buy for the price.

JohnDoe99 - 5 stars

Best screen protector I have used. Good fingerprint resistant properties - I barely need to wipe my screen anymore. The scratch resistance is top notch.

Lisa_M - 5 stars

Love these! Good fingerprint resistant surface keeps the screen looking clean. Great value for a 3-pack.

TechLover42 - 4 stars

Solid product. Installation was smooth and bubble-free. Clarity is great. Fingerprint resistance is decent but not perfect.
